finalText:
**Redis went down, and the rest fell over behind it.** The chain, over 18 minutes: ```mermaid graph LR A["Redis refuses
connections 02:14:07"] --> B["Cache off, reads
go straight to store"] B --> C["Store overloads,
5s timeouts"] C --> D["Queue 52 → 568,
cap is 500"] D --> E["worker-2 out of
memory 02:31:44"] E --> F["api killed,
service down 02:31:52"] ``` Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` never came back. All 13 reconnect tries got `ECONNREFUSED`, about 80 seconds apart, and the log ends before a 14th. Everything after 02:14 is noise from that one cause. The 188 errors are 173 store timeouts plus the 14 Redis ones and one out-of-memory. One thing worth a look: these logs are dated **2026-07-04**, not last night. Either the file is stale or you have an older incident on your hands.
